correctness.rationale: All eigenvector coordinate equations are written with exact quantifiers. At zero, the two short leaves force base amplitudes zero and the remaining equations leave only short-leaf antisymmetric vectors. At plus/minus one, the two-step leaves force base amplitudes zero and leave precisely two-step-arm antisymmetric vectors. Orthonormal bases determine all singleton spectral projection masses, so every coordinate misses a globally positive atom. Bounded-degree assures selfadjointness. The finite checker passes 208 exact assertions; the infinite proof does not depend on it.
